breast-12.title: Normal breast layers over the chest wall
breast-12.label: Breast layers over the chest wall
breast-12.credit: Geeta Shah and Bijal Jankharia, Fig. 2
breast-12.reason: Follow the labeled layers from skin to chest-wall muscle.
breast-12.note: Acquired grayscale image labeled by the authors. Labels 1–5 mark skin, subcutaneous fat, fibroglandular tissue, retromammary fat and pectoralis-region muscle. C marks Cooper’s ligaments. The source does not specify the scan plane, breast side, clock-face position, depth, age or lactation status. Converted the complete figure to lossless WebP without resizing or changing the labels.

breast-48.title: Normal nipple and duct in longitudinal view
breast-48.label: Nipple and duct, longitudinal
breast-48.reason: The source arrow points along a visible duct at the nipple.
breast-48.note: Acquired longitudinal grayscale section through the normal nipple. This reference is tightly framed around the nipple and visible duct, with little surrounding tissue. The source does not specify the breast side, clock-face position, depth, age or lactation status. Single panel cropped from the published figure and converted to lossless WebP without resizing, retaining the source arrow and panel letter. Noncommercial reuse only.

breast-layers-48.title: Normal breast layers in a mid-transverse scan
breast-layers-48.label: Breast layers, mid-transverse
breast-layers-48.reason: The bright glandular band is surrounded by darker fat.
breast-layers-48.note: The author labels this as a normal mid-transverse breast scan. The published field shows a bright fibroglandular band surrounded by fat. Side, clock-face position, depth, age, and lactation status are unreported. The left ultrasound field was cropped from the published figure at native resolution and converted to lossless WebP. Visible source markings are retained.

breast-subareolar-12.title: Normal nipple in axial view
breast-subareolar-12.label: Nipple, axial
breast-subareolar-12.reason: The normal nipple is shown in cross-section.
breast-subareolar-12.note: The source identifies this grayscale panel as the normal nipple in the axial plane. Its companion panel 1B shows the nipple longitudinally with a visible duct. Same-subject pairing, laterality, clock-face position, transducer tilt, depth, age, and lactation status are unreported. Single panel cropped at native resolution and converted to lossless WebP with the source panel letter retained. Noncommercial reuse only.
